annotations.text:
Three surfaces, one shell, no edition switch.

1 · Before sign-in exists only where an authenticator is registered. It shows the Space's branding document, the version and one SSO action. No Space roster, no edition badge, no module list.

2 + 3 · Home is one route. What appears on it is driven by bootstrap.features (module presence) and session.capabilities, never by the edition string.

Personal: no user menu, no Space switcher (single space). Events / Incidents absent from nav because those modules did not register. The amber notice renders when features.authMode is none (control plane binds every interface). Root redirects here; the Lens landing route becomes the primary button.

Enterprise: Space switcher because features.multiSpace is true; user menu because authMode is oidc. Actor name needs the bootstrap session.actor wired into a signal (dead today). Quick actions = one row per held capability; the Administer row is the first UI consumer of canAdminister. Numbers and names are SAMPLE values.
